description: Canonical record of deployed Soroban contract IDs per environment. Used by promotion-gate CI to verify that the running deployment matches expected contracts before promoting to production.

testnet.note: Shared testnet contracts used for local dev and CI staging runs.

staging.note: Staging-specific contract deployments. Update these IDs after each staging deploy.

production.note: Production mainnet contracts. Update ONLY after a successful staging rehearsal and manual approval.
